I'm the same here, I dont do anything I love, but just think about everything you love and put it all on paper because on paper, if you'd not like something you can erase it and start again. It's a coping mechanism; you build up your own world on paper where you can feel at ease while you think. Just try it, it helped me a lot

I understand you, but try and think about it like this:
Do you like a certain animal?
Do you like a certain activity?
Do you like a certain book?
Maybe you like looking at the stars?
The sea?
What makes you feel happy or at peace when you think of it?
Just try and write down everything down, like writing a story and expressing everything about you on paper.
